mappings.rationale: KBLI-2020 code 05100 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' was a single code bundling coal-mining extraction (drilling/boring, surface and underground, across coal grades — anthracite/bituminous/subbituminous) with any associated quality work. BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 (forward crosswalk, p.144/printed p.130) and Lampiran 10 (reverse crosswalk, p.336/printed p.322) both confirm, in agreement, that 05100 disaggregates into TWO 2025 codes: 05101 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' (pure extraction) and 05102 'Benefisiasi atau Peningkatan Kualitas Batu Bara'. The 05102 uraian is semantically distinct from extraction: it covers cleaning, measuring, sorting, crushing, and compacting coal to classify/improve quality or calorific value or ease transport/storage, and explicitly states this is done SEPARATELY from the coal-mining process, redirecting pure mining activity to 05101. This is a genuine activity-stage disaggregation (post-extraction processing carved out of a code that previously covered mining generically), not a straight renumbering — title similarity alone would have missed the split structure since 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' (2020) does not lexically resemble 'Benefisiasi atau Peningkatan Kualitas Batu Bara' (2025); the crosswalk tables, not the titles, are what establish the lineage.

payload.notes: Evidence quality: strong and bidirectionally consistent (Lampiran 5 forward + Lampiran 10 reverse both independently show 05100->{05101,05102}), all read from rendered PNG, no OCR-text reliance. licensing_inherits=true and flagged for D2 because pp28/394933_p202-0202.png row No.24 (Kode KBLI 05100, PP28 I.D.202) is filed under the pre-split 2020 code and its Ruang Lingkup text is mining/extraction-scoped (IUP Tahap Eksplorasi, ESDM Tinggi-risk regime) rather than beneficiation-specific — canonical.json's per_skala for 05102 inherits this row wholesale (pp28_sources=[\"05100\"], jangka_waktu_source=\"PP28_special_regime_esdm\"). D2 should image-verify whether the persyaratan/kewajiban list genuinely applies to a standalone downstream-processing activity or whether it is an unreconciled mining-licensing artifact copied across the split. status_mapping field in canonical.json currently reads \"CODICE_RINUMERATO\" which undersells the actual SPLIT structure found in evidence -- worth a data-quality note for whoever owns that field, though it does not block this D1 adjudication."

reasons: AGREE on crosswalk/mapping component: independent re-derivation from Lampiran 5 forward crosswalk (crosswalk/lampiran5_p144-144.png, printed p.130) and Lampiran 10 reverse crosswalk (crosswalk/lampiran10_p336-336.png, printed p.322) confirms, bidirectionally, that KBLI-2020 05100 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' disaggregates into TWO KBLI-2025 codes: 05101 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' and 05102 'Benefisiasi atau Peningkatan Kualitas Batu Bara'. D1's mapping_type=SPLIT and its context-driven (not title-driven) rationale independently reproduce from the same evidence.

DIVERGE on licensing-inheritance component: the sole PP28 evidence pulled (pp28/394933_p202-0202.png, Lampiran I.D p.202, row No.24, Kode KBLI 05100) is an end-to-end mining-CONCESSION regime -- IUP Tahap Kegiatan Eksplorasi through Operasi Produksi, 'Bukti Pembayaran nilai kompensasi data informasi hasil lelang WIUP Batubara' (mining-area-auction compensation proof), geologist-experience attestations, exploration-guarantee bank deposits, 'Neraca Sumber Daya dan Cadangan', post-mining reclamation plans. This is substantively an extraction-licensing package, not a downstream-processing one.

05102's own uraian (identical in canonical.json and OSS detail.json) explicitly EXCLUDES mining -- 'Kelompok ini tidak mencakup aktivitas pertambangan batu bara ... lihat kelompok 05101' -- and requires beneficiation be done 'secara terpisah dari proses pertambangan batu bara' (separately from the coal-mining process). A standalone beneficiation-only operator with no mining concession would not plausibly hold an IUP eksplorasi, undergo a WIUP auction, or file a Neraca Sumber Daya dan Cadangan -- yet canonical.json's per_skala for 05102 copies the 05100 mining-concession row wholesale (pp28_sources=['05100'], jangka_waktu_source='PP28_special_regime_esdm'). Independently re-deriving from the same PP28 image, I cannot confirm this regime genuinely transfers to the narrower 05102 scope; the content mismatch is the opposite of what 'licensing_inherits=true' with 'confidence: high' asserts.

Internal inconsistency in the D1 proposal itself: its own 'notes' field states, almost verbatim, the same doubt I independently derived ('unreconciled mining-licensing artifact copied across the split', 'whether the persyaratan/kewajiban list genuinely applies to a standalone downstream-processing activity') -- yet the machine-readable verdict fields (confidence: high, needs_quarantine: false, licensing_inherits: true) do not reflect that doubt. A proposal whose narrative flags a live, unresolved substantive risk should not simultaneously certify needs_quarantine=false at high confidence.

Evidence-completeness gap reinforces the doubt: only ONE PP28 page (Lampiran I.D p.202) was captured, explicitly hunted under the pre-split ancestor code '05100' (locator code_hunted='05100', not '05102'). No negative-control search is recorded confirming PP28's 21 lampiran files contain no beneficiation-specific or 05102-specific row elsewhere. Per this project's own established rules (kbli-navigator skill Rule #7: '404/absence needs a second independent corroborating signal', Rule #3: 'silence -> corroborated abstention, NEVER silently fill from another vintage/source without it', Rule #4: 'a wrongly-remapped fact is a lie in production'), asserting needs_quarantine=false / licensing_inherits=true on a single ancestor-code row without that corroboration is premature.

Net verdict: the crosswalk/SPLIT mapping half of the D1 proposal is CONFIRMED by independent blind re-extraction (agreement). The licensing-inheritance half (licensing_inherits=true, confidence=high, needs_quarantine=false) is REFUTED by independent blind re-extraction -- the PP28 evidence, read on its own content, is a mining-concession package that is a substantive mismatch to 05102's explicitly non-mining, separately-conducted beneficiation scope. Per D5 doctrine ('agreement certifies, divergence quarantines'), this divergence should route the dossier to needs_quarantine=true for D2/D6 to determine whether 05102 requires an honest-gap licensing note (no PP28 row genuinely covers it) rather than inheriting 05100's exploration-mining requirements wholesale.
